properties.name: Path visibility
properties.description: How strongly the planned path is drawn on the road.

properties.name: Path width
properties.description: How wide the planned path is drawn.

properties.name: Path length
properties.description: How far ahead the planned path is shown.

properties.name: Path style
properties.description: Whether the path is a plain band or carries direction arrows.

properties.name: Path motion
properties.description: Whether the path is static or flows forward.

properties.name: Manoeuvre cue
properties.description: An icon or short text naming the next manoeuvre.

properties.name: Highlight strength
properties.description: How strongly relevant road users are highlighted.

properties.name: Highlight style
properties.description: How relevant road users are marked.

properties.name: Which road users are highlighted
properties.description: Whether only road users affecting the vehicle, or all detected ones, are highlighted.

properties.name: Risk colour coding
properties.description: Whether highlight colour changes with urgency.

properties.name: Distance labels
properties.description: Distance in metres shown next to highlighted road users.

properties.name: Text size
properties.description: Size of all text in the display.

properties.name: Reason for action
properties.description: A short text explaining why the vehicle acts.

properties.name: Speed and mode indicator
properties.description: Current speed and driving mode shown on screen.

properties.name: Background dimming
properties.description: How much the parts of the scene that do not matter are darkened.

properties.name: Colour palette
properties.description: The set of colours used for the whole display.

properties.name: Contrast
properties.description: Contrast between the display and the road scene.

properties.name: When the display is shown
properties.description: Whether the display is always on or appears only when something needs explaining.

properties.name: Lead time
properties.description: How early the display appears before an event.

properties.name: Fade in and out
properties.description: Whether elements appear instantly or fade in and out.

properties.name: Information density
properties.description: How much information is shown at once.
